restoredFields.description:
EEON is the first AI voice notes app that builds your personal wiki for you.                                                                      
                                                                                
  Talk. EEON listens, extracts decisions and ideas, and auto-compiles every note into a living wiki of topics, people, and projects. No tagging. No    
  filing. Your knowledge grows itself.                                          
                                                                                                                                                       
  Voice in. Intelligence out.                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                       
  — VOICE-FIRST CAPTURE                                                                                                                              
  One tap. Speak. Whisper-quality transcription. Edit live or after.                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                       
  — AI AUTO-WIKI                                                                                                                                    
  Every note compounds into compiled articles — topics, people, projects. Open threads, decisions, sentiment arcs. The AI keeps them updated           
  automatically as your captures accumulate.  

 — TUNE EEON FOR YOU                                                                                                                                  
  Founder, journalist, dream interpreter, coach — declare who you are once. EEON's home screen, extraction lens, and voice & tone all adapt to match.
  The same app feels different for every persona.                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                       
  — FOCUS & MOMENTUM                                                            
  Declare your priorities as a drag-to-reorder list. EEON observes your capture density and surfaces the drift between what you said matters and what  
  you actually worked on this week.                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                       
  — ASK YOUR MEMORY                                                                                                                                  
  "What did I decide about pricing?" "What's the pattern across my last 30 days?" Speak or type a question. EEON answers with citations back to your   
  real notes.                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                       
  — PRIVATE BY DESIGN                                                                                                                                
  On-device storage. CloudKit sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Nothing on our servers.  

Free to start. In-app purchases unlock unlimited capture and the full AI organization layer.

Privacy: https://www.eeon.com/privacy
Terms: https://www.eeon.com/terms
